rule: Shuffle every fold 1 and 3 image (minus excluded organs) once; first 600 test, next 400 dev, rest fit.
patch_id_rule: image_index = fold offset + index within fold; offsets {1: 10000, 2: 0, 3: 30000}
independence: Patch-disjoint only. PanNuke has no patient or slide IDs. The folds HoVer-Net was trained on are unknown.
